title: Senior B2B SaaS Website Designer | Conversion-Focused UX & Figma Design System
description:
Senior B2B SaaS Website Designer | Conversion-Focused UX & Figma Design System

We're looking for an experienced B2B SaaS website designer to improve the visual quality, user experience, and conversion potential of an existing SaaS marketing website.

The product operates in the SEO and digital marketing technology industry, with AI-powered capabilities and workflow automation.

Our website is already live and functional. We're looking to elevate its design quality, improve how we communicate product value, and create a consistent, reusable design system.

This is a website design project, not an application dashboard redesign or development project.

WHAT WE NEED

1. Website UX and Visual Improvements

Review the existing website and identify opportunities to improve:

- Overall visual quality and professional appearance
- Information hierarchy and content presentation
- User experience and navigation
- Conversion-focused layouts and CTA placement
- Product feature presentation and visualization
- Typography, spacing, and visual consistency
- Desktop and mobile usability

We prefer improving the existing website rather than redesigning everything unnecessarily.

2. Core Marketing Page Designs

We'll need designs for several important B2B SaaS marketing pages, including:

- Homepage
- Main product page
- Pricing page
- Customer-specific solution pages
- Product comparison pages

The exact page list and requirements will be shared with shortlisted candidates before requesting a final quote.

3. Reusable Figma Design System

This is a key requirement.

We want a design system that our development team can reuse to build future pages while maintaining a consistent visual identity.

It should include:

- Colors, typography, spacing, and layout foundations
- Buttons, forms, navigation, cards, and other UI elements
- Reusable hero sections and feature layouts
- Product screenshot and demonstration components
- Pricing and comparison components
- Testimonials, FAQs, and CTA sections
- Responsive components and layouts
- Figma Auto Layout, component variants, and reusable styles/variables

We expect a functional, well-organized component library, not just a static style guide.

4. Product Visualization

Our SaaS product has multiple features, workflows, and AI capabilities.

We want a designer who can present complex software functionality through clear, attractive, and easy-to-understand visuals.

Experience designing websites for AI SaaS, SEO software, marketing technology, or workflow automation products is a plus.

COPYWRITING AND DEVELOPMENT

We're working with a professional B2B SaaS copywriter who is developing our positioning, messaging, and website copy.

The designer will work with the approved copy and help translate it into effective visual layouts.

Our development team will handle implementation.

We're looking for Figma design deliverables only, including responsive layouts and developer handoff.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience designing high-quality B2B SaaS marketing websites
- Strong understanding of conversion-focused website UX
- Excellent visual design skills and attention to detail
- Advanced Figma skills and experience building reusable design systems
- Ability to design effective product and feature presentations
- Experience with responsive website design
- Ability to collaborate with copywriters and developers

We prefer designers with experience working on established SaaS products rather than only designing startup landing page templates.

HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Three live B2B SaaS websites you've designed, ideally with links to the live sites.
2. Your specific role and contribution to those projects.
3. An example of a reusable Figma design system or component library you've created.
4. A brief explanation of how you approach improving an existing SaaS website's design and conversion experience.
5. Your typical pricing range for a multi-page SaaS website design project that includes a reusable design system.
6. Your availability and estimated project duration.

We're particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate both strong visual design and thoughtful conversion-focused UX.

SELECTION PROCESS

We'll review portfolios and shortlist candidates based on relevant experience and design quality.

Shortlisted designers will receive the website URL, detailed page requirements, and project scope so they can provide an accurate fixed-price proposal.

We'd prefer to start with a paid website audit and design direction before proceeding with the full project.

We're looking for someone who can help establish a professional, scalable visual foundation for our SaaS website.
